title: left and right
todayLead: Today we are going to learn

shared.text: Welcome to Melody and Barnaby's Music Nuggets!
See you for the next Nugget!

clips.text: Last time, <break time="0.45s" /> we found groups <break time="0.3s" /> of two and three.
clips.show: Last time, we found groups of two and three.

clips.text: Today we are going to learn <break time="0.35s" /> left and right, <break time="0.4s" /> and higher <break time="0.3s" /> and lower.
clips.show: Today we are going to learn left and right, and higher and lower.

clips.text: Hold up your hands. <break time="0.5s" /> Look at them.
clips.show: Hold up your hands. Look at them.

clips.text: This is your left hand.
Make an L <break time="0.4s" /> with your thumb and finger. <break time="0.5s" /> That is your left hand.
clips.show: Make an L with your thumb and finger. That is your left hand.

clips.text: This is your right hand.
Left.
Right.
Show me your left hand.
Show me your right hand.
Left and right take lots of practice. <break time="0.4s" /> That is okay! <break time="0.4s" /> Ask a grown-up to practise with you.
clips.show: Left and right take lots of practice. That is okay! Ask a grown-up to practise with you.

clips.text: Now let's look at the piano.
A piano has a left end, <break time="0.5s" /> and a right end.
clips.show: A piano has a left end, and a right end.

clips.text: Listen to the left end.
Low.
Now listen to the right end.
High.
clips.prev: Now listen to the right end.

clips.text: Left is low. <break time="0.5s" /> Right is high.
clips.show: Left is low. Right is high.

clips.text: Your left hand plays the low sounds. <break time="0.6s" /> Your right hand plays the high sounds.
clips.show: Your left hand plays the low sounds. Your right hand plays the high sounds.

clips.text: Your turn! <break time="0.4s" /> Is this sound high, <break time="0.4s" /> or low?
clips.show: Your turn! Is this sound high, or low?

clips.text: Low!
clips.prev: Is this sound high, or low?

clips.text: Which hand plays this low sound?
Left!
clips.prev: Which hand plays this low sound?

clips.text: Is this sound on the left end, <break time="0.4s" /> or the right end?
clips.show: Is this sound on the left end, or the right end?

clips.text: Right!
clips.prev: Is this sound on the left end, or the right end?

clips.text: You've got it!
Play Left, Right, High and Low, <break time="0.3s" /> and practise with your hands!
clips.show: Play Left, Right, High and Low, and practise with your hands!
